Title: OTP grant — the same code cannot sign in twice
Section: Auth > OTP Sign-In > API
Preconditions:
OtpSignIn.Enabled is on for {{STORE_ID}}; {{USER_EMAIL}} is a contact of {{STORE_ID}} with lockout enabled and a non-expired password
admin credentials resolve
Sign-in log recording is enabled (Settings > Platform > Sign In Log > Record sign-in attempts = On)
Steps: [AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}) to obtain an admin Bearer token [CAPTURE] T0 = current UTC time, taken immediately before the code is requested [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer token and JSON body {"keyword":"{{USER_EMAIL}}","take":10,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [CAPTURE] knownIds = the ids of the journal rows that call returned, taken immediately before the code is requested [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/otp/request, no Authorization header, JSON body {"storeId":"{{STORE_ID}}","email":"{{USER_EMAIL}}"} [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer token and JSON body {"keyword":"{{USER_EMAIL}}","take":10,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [WAIT] poll that call up to 90s until an OtpSignInEmailNotification message to {{USER_EMAIL}} whose id is NOT in knownIds appears (SMTP may be off - the message is journaled either way); no message in 90s = BLOCKED, never FAIL [CAPTURE] code = the 6-digit value inside ... in that message body [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=otp_email, scope=offline_access, storeId={{STORE_ID}}, email={{USER_EMAIL}}, code=code [CAPTURE] firstToken = access_token of the first grant [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=otp_email, scope=offline_access, storeId={{STORE_ID}}, email={{USER_EMAIL}}, code=code - the SAME code again, immediately [WAIT] 65 seconds [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=otp_email, scope=offline_access, storeId={{STORE_ID}}, email={{USER_EMAIL}}, code=code - the SAME code a THIRD time, 65 seconds after the first grant [HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/currentuser with firstToken (the first session itself stays valid) [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/sign-in-log/search with the admin Bearer token and body {"userName":"{{USER_EMAIL}}","startDate":"","take":50,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [WAIT] poll the search up to 90s until the OTP success row and both refused-repeat rows appear (the writer is buffered - one immediate read is not evidence of absence)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] no unexpected 5xx on the endpoint under test
[API] response body is valid JSON with the documented error shape
[ADMIN] Security > Sign-in log shows the OTP rows for the account
Failure_Signals: The same code accepted a second time: 200 with an access_token (the code stays valid for its whole lifetime - the VCST-6490 defect, fixed from VirtoCommerce.OTP 3.1002.0-pr-4); a refusal other than 400 invalid_grant with code invalid_code; the first session invalidated by the second grant; 4xx/5xx other than the asserted one, empty or malformed response body, an access_token where a refusal is expected; a refused repeat missing from the sign-in log or logged as anything but an OTP InvalidCode row
Cleanup: Reset the failed-attempt counter of {{USER_EMAIL}}: the repeat grant above is refused and counts as a failed attempt on this SHARED persona, so request a fresh code and grant with it once (a successful grant zeroes the counter)

record the response and elapsedSeconds = seconds since that code was requested (it may have expired during the wait) [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer token and JSON body {"keyword":"@td(OTP_LOCKOUT_USER_1.email)","take":10,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [CAPTURE] knownIds = the ids of the journal rows that call returned, taken immediately before the code is requested [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/otp/request, no Authorization header, JSON body {"storeId":"{{STORE_ID}}","email":"@td(OTP_LOCKOUT_USER_1.email)"} [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer token and JSON body {"keyword":"@td(OTP_LOCKOUT_USER_1.email)","take":10,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [WAIT] poll that call up to 90s until an OtpSignInEmailNotification message to @td(OTP_LOCKOUT_USER_1.email) whose id is NOT in knownIds appears (SMTP may be off - the message is journaled either way); no message in 90s = BLOCKED, never FAIL [CAPTURE] freshCode = the 6-digit value inside ... in that message body [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=otp_email, scope=offline_access, storeId={{STORE_ID}}, email=@td(OTP_LOCKOUT_USER_1.email), code=freshCode - a code requested AFTER the lock ended [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/sign-in-log/search with the admin Bearer token and body {"userName":"@td(OTP_LOCKOUT_USER_1.email)","startDate":"","take":50,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [WAIT] poll the search up to 90s until the locked row appears (the writer is buffered)

[NETWORK] no unexpected 5xx on the endpoint under test
[API] response body is valid JSON with the documented error shape
[ADMIN] Security > Sign-in log shows the OTP rows for the account
Failure_Signals: More than N wrong codes without a lock (guessing is free); a locked account signs in with the right code; the lock never expires; lockout rows missing or typed Password; 4xx/5xx other than the asserted one, empty or malformed response body, an access_token where a refusal is expected; a freshly requested code refused after the lock ended

Title: OTP request - Resend issues a second code and accepting it refuses the first
Section: Auth > OTP Sign-In > API
Preconditions:
OtpSignIn.Enabled is on for {{STORE_ID}}; {{USER_EMAIL}} is a contact of {{STORE_ID}} with lockout enabled
admin credentials resolve
Two different codes: the Resend is requested in the next epoch-aligned 3-minute window (inside one window both requests email the SAME digits, KB-38B0EAE3). No code lifetime is asserted.
The refused code1 counts as a failed attempt on this SHARED persona; Cleanup zeroes it (at most one failure between two successes).
Steps: [AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}) to obtain an admin Bearer token [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer token and body {"keyword":"{{USER_EMAIL}}","take":10,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [CAPTURE] knownIds = the ids of the journal rows that call returned, taken immediately before the code is requested [CAPTURE] w1 = floor(UTC epoch seconds / 180), taken immediately before the first request [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/otp/request, no Authorization header, JSON body {"storeId":"{{STORE_ID}}","email":"{{USER_EMAIL}}"} [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer token and body {"keyword":"{{USER_EMAIL}}","take":10,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [WAIT] poll that call up to 90s until an OtpSignInEmailNotification message to {{USER_EMAIL}} whose id is NOT in knownIds appears (SMTP may be off - the message is journaled either way); no message in 90s = BLOCKED, never FAIL [CAPTURE] code1 = the 6-digit value inside ... in that message body [WAIT] until the runner's next 3-minute UTC boundary (floor(UTC epoch seconds / 180) increases by exactly 1) plus a 10 s margin - the stand's clock can run behind the runner's, so a request made right on the boundary can still land in the earlier window; wait for the boundary plus the margin, never a fixed sleep [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer token and body {"keyword":"{{USER_EMAIL}}","take":10,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [CAPTURE] knownIds = the ids of the journal rows that call returned, taken immediately before the code is requested [CAPTURE] w2 = floor(UTC epoch seconds / 180) immediately before the Resend (w2 must be w1 + 1, otherwise BLOCKED) [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/otp/request, no Authorization header, JSON body {"storeId":"{{STORE_ID}}","email":"{{USER_EMAIL}}"} - the Resend, in the next window [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer token and body {"keyword":"{{USER_EMAIL}}","take":10,"sort":"createdDate:desc"} [WAIT] poll that call up to 90s until an OtpSignInEmailNotification message to {{USER_EMAIL}} whose id is NOT in knownIds appears (SMTP may be off - the message is journaled either way); no message in 90s = BLOCKED, never FAIL [CAPTURE] code2 = the 6-digit value inside ... in that message body; sameCode = whether code1 equals code2 [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=otp_email, scope=offline_access, storeId={{STORE_ID}}, email={{USER_EMAIL}}, code=code2 [HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (application/x-www-form-urlencoded): grant_type=otp_email, scope=offline_access, storeId={{STORE_ID}}, email={{USER_EMAIL}}, code=code1 - the EARLIER code, after code2 signed in
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] no unexpected 5xx on the endpoint under test
[API] response body is valid JSON with the documented error shape
Failure_Signals: The resend sends no message; the latest code is refused; the earlier code still signs in after the latest was accepted; the two codes are equal although the requests sit in different windows; a 5xx on the second request; 4xx/5xx other than the asserted one, empty or malformed response body, an access_token where a refusal is expected
Cleanup: Reset the failed-attempt counter of {{USER_EMAIL}}: the refused code1 counts as a failed attempt on this SHARED persona, so request a fresh code and grant with it once (a successful grant zeroes the counter)
